description: Customize the JStock watchlist view by removing the market depth columns to create a cleaner interface. Open the column settings (usually via right-clicking the table header) and HIDE the 'Buy', 'B.Qty', 'Sell', and 'S.Qty' columns. Ensure that the 'High' and 'Low' columns remain VISIBLE. The goal is to declutter the view for a long-term investor who doesn't need real-time bid/ask data.
